description: Oracle Agent Spec agent with one server tool, traced by OpenInference's Agent Spec instrumentor.
notes: pyagentspec 26.3.1 with its langgraph extra in envs/agentspec, plus openinference-instrumentation-agentspec 0.1.22. Only AgentSpecInstrumentor is enabled. The LangGraph adapter builds ChatOpenAI with no base_url (it ignores OpenAiConfig.url), so the program sets OPENAI_BASE_URL to the mock before pyagentspec loads. The tool is a ServerTool read_file(path) whose callable comes from AgentSpecLoader's tool_registry; it reads hello.txt from the working directory. Expected: AgentExecution[assistant] (agent), LlmGenerationSpan twice (llm, with input and output messages), ToolExecution[read_file] (tool). No span carries an instrumentation scope. The adapter writes the string "null" into every token count it does not know; the Agent Spec amendment to normalization rule 20 (D-IN-31 item 5) reads those as absent, so the llm spans have no token columns, no invalid_number warning, and no cost. Volatile: session.id is the trace's uuid4; agent.id, agent.llm_config.id and agent.tools.0.id are the components' uuid4s (the llm_config id also sits inside agent.llm_config.api_key.$component_ref); tool_call.id, request_id and the events' id are LangChain run uuid7s (request_id also sits inside completion_id); tools.0.id is the converted client tool's uuid4. Every event carries its timestamp as an attribute in nanoseconds, listed in timestamp_attributes.
